warnings: The large dark contextual story scrim remains visually dominant in several screenshots and may still be perceived as polished Web-demo framing.
The revised flow does not require inspecting all three bearings or enforce dwell time; human replay must judge whether voluntary observation creates enough situation and deliberation.
Physical-device accessibility, complete WCAG conformance, and all five failed human experience dimensions remain unverified until human replay.
Touch evidence is emulated rather than physical-device observation.
Automated accessibility scanning does not establish WCAG conformance.
humanOnlyLimitations: Automation and independent implementation review cannot determine whether decision motivation, immersion, perceptible consequence, felt agency, pacing, narrative tone, mobile usability, or medium quality now succeed for a human.
